{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Filter to only completed orders (since refunded orders are not conversions)
filtered_df = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute raw conversion rates by channel
raw_email_rate = filtered_df[filtered_df['channel'] == 'email']['converted'].mean()
raw_paid_search_rate = filtered_df[filtered_df['channel'] == 'paid_search']['converted'].mean()
raw_diff = raw_email_rate - raw_paid_search_rate

# Compute conversion rates within each customer segment
segment_differences = []

for segment in ['new', 'returning', 'loyal']:
    subset = filtered_df[filtered_df['customer_segment'] == segment]
    email_rate = subset[subset['channel'] == 'email']['converted'].mean()
    paid_search_rate = subset[subset['channel'] == 'paid_search']['converted'].mean()
    diff = email_rate - paid_search_rate
    segment_differences.append((segment, email_rate, paid_search_rate, diff))

# Convert to DataFrame
diff_df = pd.DataFrame(segment_differences, columns=['segment', 'email_rate', 'paid_search_rate', 'diff'])

# Compute total number of orders in each segment (for weighting)
segment_counts = filtered_df['customer_segment'].value_counts()

# Compute weighted average of differences
weighted_diff = 0
for segment in ['new', 'returning', 'loyal']:
    count = segment_counts[segment]
    diff = diff_df[diff_df['segment'] == segment]['diff'].iloc[0]
    weighted_diff += count * diff

weighted_diff /= segment_counts.sum()

# Now, print only the numbers that will be in the evidence
# Ensure each is printed exactly once
print(raw_email_rate)
print(raw_paid_search_rate)
print(raw_diff)
print(diff_df[diff_df['segment'] == 'new']['diff'].iloc[0])
print(diff_df[diff_df['segment'] == 'returning']['diff'].iloc[0])
print(diff_df[diff_df['segment'] == 'loyal']['diff'].iloc[0])
print(segment_counts['new'])
print(segment_counts['returning'])
print(segment_counts['loyal'])
print(weighted_diff)"}
